column1: As of: June 10 2026 | Phase 1: Go-Live Sep 30 2026 | Phase 2: Go-Live Jan 4 2027
Note: Specific data fields per object will be jointly specified during the refinement period (14 days from signing).

column4: Description
The dashboard shows metrics calculated automatically by the system: active clients (with trend), onboarding pipeline (by status) and staff status (nurses with capacity).

Six risk indicators on the dashboard: SRC course overdue, re-assessment due, residence permit B pending, withholding tax registration open, child allowance application open, salary adjustment after SRC.
Anna shows a daily updated briefing on the dashboard that adapts to the role: nurse sees client focus, back office sees billing focus, management sees pipeline focus.
All active onboarding cases in a filterable list. Per case: patient, caregiver, start date, responsible person, current status (In Capture, Incomplete, Blocked).

Step-by-step assistant with three main steps: 1) Caregiver data (HR), 2) Patient data (clinical + documents), 3) Contract signing. For residence permit B an additional special permit step appears automatically.

Complete capture of all HR-relevant data: personal details, residence permit status (A–N), withholding tax, partner data (conditional on marriage/WHT), children and allowances, employment data (hourly wage, IBAN), mandatory documents.

column4: Capture in multiple tabs: Personal data, Social & Tax, Medical history, Activities of daily living (ADL), Documents. Clinical tabs (InterRAI, Care Planning, KLV) are only included in Phase 2.
column7: Fields to be specified during refinement period

column4: The onboarding header always shows the current status (Draft / In Progress / Ready to Complete) and clickable summaries: workflow progress and missing documents.

column3: Special Permit for Residence Permit B
column4: Residence permit B automatically requires submission of a special permit from the migration authority. Contract signing is blocked until proof is uploaded.
Residence permit G (cross-border) displays a prominent warning with direct upload option for the permit G document. Capture is not blocked but the action required is clearly visible.
Dependent children or child allowances through Spitex generate an informational hint: family book or birth certificate must be uploaded.

Four documents (job description, employment contract, privacy policy, consent form) are signed by finger or stylus directly on the tablet/phone. Signature with timestamp and name. The employment contract must be signed before onboarding can be completed.
The canvas signature is exported as an image and embedded in the signed PDF. A signature record (document hash, timestamp, signer) ensures the document was not altered after signing.
Overview of all contracts to be signed per mandate with status (open/signed). Signed documents are archived with embedded signature.
The data privacy consent form can be signed in two ways: digitally in the contract step or as a scan upload in the documents tab. Both paths update the same status — single source of truth.
After successful completion of onboarding, a patient record and a caregiver record are automatically created. All captured data and documents are transferred.

Missing mandatory documents do not absolutely block completion. A dialog lists missing documents by name and requires a written justification. The justification is documented on the case. The employment contract remains a hard lock (no override possible).

Medical diagnoses (ICD codes) can be manually entered with code, description and source. They are a standalone record on the case and serve as the medical basis for care planning and KLV justification.
All patients in a filterable table. Views: All, Mine, Attention. Per row: name, severity, status, assigned nurse, next task. With search and sorting.
360-degree profile with tabs: Overview, Medical History, Care Planning, KLV, Documents, Workflow, Activities.
Master data (personal details, contact, insurance, physician) can be edited directly in the patient detail page — not only during onboarding.

column4: Status (Active, Paused, Ended) can be changed via a dialog with confirmation.
AHV number, IBAN and other sensitive numbers are hidden by default. Reveal only through deliberate click.
Documents tab with folder structure (8 categories). Per document: upload (file or camera scan), preview, delete. Documents are stored in SharePoint.
The relationship between patients and caregivers is displayed and can be edited (one patient can have multiple caregivers and vice versa). Direct navigation between linked records.
A service desk ticket can be created directly from the patient detail page, automatically linked to the patient.
All caregivers in a filterable table. Views: All, Mine, Attention, SRC open, In Onboarding. Per row: name, HR status, SRC progress, stamp warnings.
360-degree profile with tabs: Overview, Personal/HR, Family/Tax, Bank Details, Documents, Monthly Steps.
Master data (personal details, HR data, withholding tax, family, bank details) can be edited directly in the caregiver detail page.

column4: Automatic check of SRC course status, withholding tax registration and residence permit document. Result as colored indicator: green (done), yellow (pending), red (overdue).
Warning when the SRC care course is not completed within one year of contract signing. Shows remaining time and affected patients.
AHV number, ZEMIS number and IBAN are displayed masked. Reveal only through deliberate click.
Documents can be uploaded directly from the caregiver detail page to the associated SharePoint folder (scan or file).
A service desk ticket can be created directly from the caregiver detail page, automatically linked to the caregiver.
Workflow tasks (automatically generated) and service tickets (manually created) are displayed in a combined overview.
Tasks are grouped by due date: Overdue, Today, This Week, Later. With counter per group.
Service desk tickets can be manually created with title, description, type, priority and assignment. Existing tickets can be edited: change status, add comments, reassign.
Workflow steps automatically create tasks when due (e.g. SRC registration due creates a task for the responsible person).
Workflow steps can be checked off, assigned to a person and given a due date. The checklist is available in onboarding, patient detail and caregiver detail.
Connection to SharePoint for persistent document storage. A folder structure (8 categories) is automatically created per patient and caregiver.
Documents can be scanned via the device camera. The scan is automatically converted to PDF and stored in the associated SharePoint folder.
Search field in the header bar with instant results. Searches across patients, caregivers and tasks.
Detail pages offer a back button and previous/next navigation for browsing through lists.
Users can be created, edited and deactivated. Three roles: Registered Nurse, Back Office, Management. Roles are assigned per user.
Production login with secure passwords, automatic logout after inactivity and brute-force protection.
Every area of the application is only accessible to authorized roles. Verification is server-side, not just in the display.
All access to sensitive data (e.g. revealing AHV number, changing status, opening document) is logged with timestamp, user and action.
Sensitive data (AHV, ZEMIS, IBAN, medical information) is stored and transmitted encrypted.
Production database with data migration mechanism. All data is preserved after restart or update.
Multiple people can work with the application simultaneously without data loss or overwriting each other.
Three user roles with adapted visibility: nurse sees client focus, back office sees HR and billing data, management sees metrics and compliance.
All InterRAI assessments in a filterable list: All, In Progress, Completed, Re-Assessment Due.
Workspace for capturing InterRAI items with navigation, collapsible sections and automatic prioritization (uncertain items are highlighted).
Approx. 225 official InterRAI HC Switzerland items in sections A through S with all answer options.
Completed assessments show all captured items, CAP results and outcome scales in a protected view.
Outcome scales (ADL, IADL, CPS etc.) with bar charts, triggered CAPs with priority, section overview.
Capture and editing of nursing diagnoses (NANDA codes), interventions and goals. Diagnoses with rationale and linked interventions/goals.
Selection from 12 NANDA diagnoses with suggested interventions and goals. Suggestions are automatically offered when adding.

column3: Medical and Nursing Diagnoses Displayed Separately
column4: Medical diagnoses (ICD) appear as compact reference lines, nursing diagnoses (NANDA) as detailed cards with interventions and goals.
Nursing diagnoses reference medical diagnoses, KLV services reference nursing diagnoses. Complete justification chain for the insurance company.
Workspace for KLV prescriptions with 7 steps: Draft → Reviewed → With Physician → Returned → With Insurance → Cost Approval / Rejected.
Complete Spitex service catalog with approx. 170 positions, times and KLV categories.
Calculation of hours per week per position and totals by category. Considers rhythm, quantity and simultaneous services.
Automatic warning when a service is already included in another (e.g. full body wash includes hair washing).
Warning when insurance-specific limits are exceeded (e.g. max days or minutes). Informational only, no automatic rejection.
Per service position a justification draft for effectiveness, appropriateness and efficiency is created — as basis for insurance controlling.
The KLV tab shows confirmed medical diagnoses as header information — directly from the shared diagnosis artifact, no double entry.
Inclusive rules, insurance rules and WZW mappings are table-based. New rules can be added without code changes.
The nurse can record a conversation. After stopping, suggestions for InterRAI items, nursing diagnoses and KLV positions are automatically generated.
A bar at the top of the screen shows the recording status: running (with timer), processing, result (with links to generated suggestions).
Connection to a speech recognition service for real-time transcription with speaker attribution.
The recording button sits directly in the tab bar and is always reachable, even when switching tabs.
Prepared email with editable subject and body. Fixed parts (attachment note, sender) are visible but not editable. Reset to template available.

column3: Anna Extracts Diagnoses from Physician Response
column4: After receiving the physician response Anna extracts diagnoses and presents them as suggestions for review. No automatic acceptance.
The steps 'Physician contacted' and 'Diagnosis received' are automatically marked as done when the physician request flow reaches the corresponding status.
Sending prepared emails to physicians with attachment (signed consent form). Recipient verification before sending.
Reception of incoming emails (e.g. physician response with diagnosis list). Assignment to case and attachment processing.
Automatic or manual reminders for overdue physician requests.
Chat interface on the home page for asking questions to Anna with card display and follow-up question suggestions.
Anna greets appropriately depending on the area and shows relevant summaries.
Anna answers questions with structured responses and action suggestions.
Anna detects danger and warning situations and highlights them in color.
Anna as assistant in a sidebar (desktop) or fullscreen (mobile), accessible from any area.
Intelligent response engine for summaries, daily briefings and follow-up question suggestions.
Anna automatically detects the current area and adapts greetings and suggestions accordingly.
Connection to a language model for real free-text processing instead of fixed rules. Contextual understanding and flexible responses.
Automatic extraction of diagnoses and medications from scanned physician letters. Results as suggestions for manual review.
Prioritized hint line: e.g. 'Physician response received' or 'Request ready to send' with jump to relevant area.
Each task type has an Anna configuration: explanation, specific action buttons, priority.
Anna shows a suggestion area per task with contextual info and quick actions.
Aggregated metrics for leadership: open/overdue tasks, staff workload, critical cases.
Automatic suggestion of the best-fitting nurse based on language (40%), skills (25%), region (20%) and capacity (15%).
The three best matches with score, criteria breakdown and contact details.
Allocation directly from the patient list via a sidebar — without page change.
Generation of printable PDFs for service planning sheet, needs assessment form and other forms directly from captured data.
Real-time notifications for relevant events (new task, physician response, overdue task).
